best_cost: minimum measured actual KV Capacity among near-optimal; then fewer reaccess layers; then frozen candidate order
best_query: max Query Accuracy; then frozen candidate order
threshold_interpretation: exploratory engineering screening, not noninferiority proof
confirmation_rule: SEARCH_CONFIRMED only if selected cost candidate Holdout Query improvement vs R0 >0pp and Non-Query difference >=-1pp; report CI uncertainty separately, never retune
